lines.en: I crawl along the shallow swamp floor.
Two horns stick out from my head.
I shift slowly through the mud.
One tail beat and I slide forward.
I slip through a patch of waterweed.
The muddy water clouds up.
I crawl up beside a stone.
My head horns brace me.
I pause at the water's edge to look.
Wet mud clings to my belly.
I crawl toward deeper water.
Mangrove roots block my way.
I glide over a fallen leaf.
I turn slowly toward the bank.
Light on the water shifts over me.
I sink back into the shallows.
I lie still on the bottom.
My two horns look like a lyre.
I wait for the current, mouth half open.
A loach swims past me.
I bury my body in the mud.
Ripples ring out on the surface.
My skin stays wet.
I hear something moving on the bank.
I flatten myself out.
Weeds drift over my back.
I stay still for a long while.
A patch of mud dried on my horns.
You're standing knee-deep in water.
I lift my head toward your feet.
The mud under you is soft.
My horns are just under the surface.
I'm lying beside your feet.
Only half a foot of water separates us.
I slowly pull my neck in.
It's just the two of us in the water.
I keep watching your ankles.
I rolled right over.
My tail got struck.
I pull back into the bottom mud.
The water suddenly got much murkier.
I slowly steadied myself.
The mud rubbed off my back.
That one was heavy.
There's a new mark on my horns.
Is that a bug?
It drifted right in front of me.
I slowly open my mouth.
This is hard to bite.
I try swallowing it.
It's not alive; I won't eat it.
I nudge it drifting back.
You threw it further away.
That's not nearly enough.
I prefer things that swim.

lines.zh: 笠头螈的扁尾巴，被你踩进泥里。
lines.en: You pressed the diplocaulus's flat tail into the mud.
I whip my body away.
I flip right over.
I am all slime; you cannot hold me.
You stomped down and I slipped off.
The surface is churned up.
The stones underwater are slippery.
You almost lost your footing.

lines.zh: 我绕着你的腿转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle once around your legs.
This shallow flat has room for two.
Are you waiting for the current too?
Our horns look very much alike.
I press my body beside yours.
Buried in mud together is safer.
I tap my tail slowly.
The waterweed will hide us.
Shift a little toward the deep water.
We don't often come this close.
Let's stay like this a while.
I catch a small piece of something.
It slips out of my mouth.
This is a slippery stone.
It isn't something to eat.
Your thing has sunk to the bottom.
I shove it up with my horns.
The water carried it away.
I push it into the shallows.
I look, then let it go.
Your legs stand out clearly in the water.
I swim slowly toward your side.
The water's clouding — just as I like.
I rise up from the bottom.

lines.zh: 你的靴子挡不住我的角。
lines.en: Your boots won't stop my horns.
I slide along the muddy bottom.
You can't move fast in shallow water.
I lower my head a little.
That shadow on the water is mine.
I'm waiting for you to lift a foot.
You stepped into the shallow mud.
I follow along the muddy bottom.
The mud you stepped in is still bubbling.
I watch through a gap in the weeds.
You're still over in the shallows.
I give my tail a gentle swing.
Only the faintest ripples show.
You keep walking deeper.
The mud is soft there; you'll stumble.
I'm only a foot from you.

lines.zh: 你的手在水里划了一下。
lines.en: You swept a hand through the water.
The bottom favors me over the bank.
I've come half a foot closer.
My horns strike your ankle.
I bite into your calf.
Muddy water splashes all over you.
I coil around your foot.
This push is all I can manage.
You braced yourself in the water.
I slid back down to the bottom.
I open my mouth and bite again.
The water's churned into a mess.
You've stepped back two paces.
I slowly sink down.
I come up out of the muddy bottom.
A string of bubbles breaks the surface.
My head surfaces first.
My two horns part the water.

lines.zh: 这里是红树和沼泽之间。
lines.en: This is between the mangroves and the marsh.
Waterweed covers half of me.
I sink and rise again slowly.
Sun comes through the water onto the mud.
The smell of mud is strong.
I begin swimming toward the bank.
I'm not conspicuous here.
The shallow water suits me well.
The water grew hot — very unpleasant.

lines.zh: 水把我按在底下动不了。
lines.en: The water holds me under.
The water got thrown up by the blast.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西扎进我的侧腹。
lines.en: Something sharp pierced my flank.

lines.zh: 我这颗扁脑袋，贴在水底打颤。
lines.en: My flat head shivers against the riverbed.
Hunger leaves me little strength to swim.
The current ran through the water and me.

lines.zh: 水里忽然什么都没有了。
lines.en: The water suddenly fell away.
